text:
alex_s: Quick sync — Meridian Bank kickoff in 30m. Need a short scoping thread we can share after the call: primary asks are (1) define 3 demo journeys, (2) success criteria for each, (3) minimal endpoints + prompts, (4) timeline + high-level pricing ask. I’ll capture notes live.

sam_se: copying my checklist. propose we prioritize by revenue impact + integration effort. my suggested order: 1) Account opening assistant (doc ingestion + Q/A), 2) Transaction dispute summarizer (batch + extractive), 3) Fraud alert triage (real-time rerank).

anya_pm: +1 on order. For success criteria, recommend we keep it simple for the pilot: 1) functional pass (workflow end-to-end), 2) quality baseline (task-specific evals), 3) perf SLOs. example KPIs below.

sam_se: endpoints we’ll need (minimal):
```
POST /v1/generate    # assistant + prompts
POST /v1/embeddings  # document search + ingestion
POST /v1/rerank      # prioritize alerts/disputes
GET  /v1/health
```

sam_se: sample prompt patterns: 
- account-opening: "You are a compliance assistant. Given applicant doc text, extract full_name, dob, id_type, flags. Return JSON."
- dispute-summary: "Summarize the dispute and list top 3 supporting evidence lines."
- fraud-triage: "Score alert 0-100 and recommend action: ignore, review, block."

anya_pm: Success criteria (proposal):
- Account opening assistant: precision on id extraction >= 95% on dev set; end-to-end completeness >= 90% (all required fields present).
- Dispute summarizer: ROUGE-L > 0.45 and manual review helpfulness >= 4/5 on 20 examples.
- Fraud triage: recall of high-severity alerts >= 95%, false positive rate < 8%.
- Platform SLOs: p95 latency for /v1/generate < 200ms for single-turn demo; uptime >= 99.5% during trial window.

neal_sec: Security/ops checklist to answer for their security team:
- data residency: which region + retention policy
- VPC / private endpoint support (we can offer VPC peering for Dedicated)
- encryption at rest + in transit (we have KMS integrations)
- logs/audit: what’s retained and how to request redaction
- model auditability: model versions used and deterministic seeds for evals
Please flag which of these Meridian requires; I’ll prepare standard artifacts.

alex_s: Meridian asked for SOC2 + an option for tenant isolation. They also want to know if PII can be stripped before calling the API.

neal_sec: we can provide DPA and SOC2 report. For PII stripping we can add a pre-processing step in the demo pipeline (fast regex scrub + named-entity filter). Note: explain residual risk to customer.

liz_legal: Legal notes: include DPA + Data Processing Addendum early, and confirm if they need an additional contractual clause for cryptographic key ownership (HSM) — that affects Private deployments. I’ll draft a short rider.

tanya_custsuccess: Implementation plan for pilot (2-phase):
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): dataset ingestion rules, access + creds, security Qs answered.
- Week 1 (spike, 5 business days): build minimal ingestion + wire /v1/embeddings + small prompt set; smoke tests.
- Week 2-3 (pilot, 10 business days): build demo flows, run evals on 100-200 examples, iterate prompts.
- Week 4 (wrap, 2 business days): acceptance review + handoff doc.
Total ~4 weeks from start to acceptance.

alex_s: pricing ask from them: which is cheaper for a 4-week pilot of expected 200k tokens generated + 50k embedding tokens — hosted usage or short-term Dedicated? Need a ballpark they can sign off on today.

anya_pm: ballpark: hosted = usage-based: approx $X for generation + $Y for embeddings (I’ll fill numbers after we get exact token estimate). Dedicated short-term has upfront commit; likely not economical for 4 weeks unless they want reserved throughput after pilot. Recommend hosted for pilot, Dedicated for production.

sam_se: ops note: to meet the latency SLO for fraud triage in demos we should enable KV caching and a small batch size. I’ll add suggested runtime config and a seed prompt set to the demo repo.

alex_s: Action items (captured):
- sam_se: share minimal endpoint playbook + prompt examples by EOD today.
- neal_sec: list of security artifacts + SOC2 + DPA draft by tomorrow.
- liz_legal: rider for HSM clause if Meridian asks.
- anya_pm: fill ballpark pricing numbers (hosted vs short Dedicated) and acceptance test template.
- tanya_custsuccess: send pilot timeline to Meridian and book next checkpoint.

deploy-bot: scheduled: demo-env-reservation on 2026-02-12 09:00 UTC (reservation id r-9421) :white_check_mark:

alex_s: Great — running into the call. I’ll paste notes from Meridian as we go. Please keep thread updates short. :thumbsup:
